content.text:
You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a simple concurrent ring algorithm with N processes arranged in a circle. Each process first sets its own x entry to 1, then copies the left neighbor's x value into its own y entry; the specification includes the PlusCal algorithm in comments and its translated TLA+ form with variables x, y, and pc. The model assumes N is a positive natural number, defines the behavior with Init, Next, and Spec, asserts termination as eventual completion of all processes, and proves a safety property stating that when all processes are done, at least one process has y[i] = 1. The file also develops an inductive invariant Inv, includes type correctness constraints, and contains TLAPS proofs of the main correctness theorem in two versions.
